claims.location: comment[label], characteristics[treatment], characteristics[compound], characteristics[dose], characteristics[exposure duration]
claims.value: light = DMSO control; medium (Arg6/Lys4) = 6 uM nocodazole 1 h; heavy (Arg10/Lys8) = 6 uM taxol (paclitaxel) 30 min
claims.evidence: Paper Fig. 1E legend: 'U2OS cells labelled with light (Lys0, Arg0), medium (Lys4, Arg6) or heavy (Lys8, Arg10) amino acids were treated with either DMSO alone (control), nocodazole or taxol, respectively'; Table S1: 'control (Light labeled), Nocodazole (Medium labeled), and Taxol (Heavy labeled)'; Methods: '6 uM of nocodazole for 1 h or 6 uM of taxol for 30 min at 37C alongside a DMSO control'. Data (proteinGroups): tubulins depleted in medium (TUBA1B log2 M/L -3.26, TUBB -2.62) and enriched in heavy (TUBA1B H/L +0.67, TUBB +0.56), as expected for depolymerised vs stabilised microtubules.

claims.value: microtubule cytoskeleton (GO:0015630): residual MT fraction after LMS cytosol extraction, three channels mixed 1:1:1
claims.evidence: PRIDE/paper: cytosolic proteins extracted with LMS buffer, residual material incl. microtubules collected; 'Extracted microtubules from each condition were combined in a 1:1:1 ratio'

claims.value: one SDS-PAGE lane cut into 12 slices = fractions 1-12; SILAC_1_REp2 = slice 1 tech rep 2; Blank_SILAC_7 = slice 7 tech rep 2; SILAC_1_Set1 = slice 12 tech rep 2
claims.evidence: PRIDE: 'The sample lane was cut into 12 equal slices'. evidence.txt peptide Jaccard: adjacent slices 0.12-0.21; SILAC_1_Set1 vs SILAC_12 = 0.81 (vs 0.20 to SILAC_11), log2 M/L correlation r=0.95 over 2615 shared features -> re-injection of slice 12 despite the file name. SILAC_7 has IDs only at RT 29.6-42.8 min (aborted, 4958 MS scans) and Blank_SILAC_7 at RT 49.4-106.2 min; both overlap slices 6 and 8 (J 0.05-0.07) -> slice 7 material. summary.txt: SILAC_1 (3 MS/MS) and SILAC_1_REp2 (13 MS/MS) have no identifications (failed injections of slice 1).

claims.evidence: parameters.txt: MaxQuant 1.6.17.0, MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm; main search 4.5 ppm is the MaxQuant default; summary.txt Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, Labels2 Arg10;Lys8, enzyme Trypsin/P; PRIDE: 'Peptides were cleaved with 3 ug trypsin'

claims.value: U2OS, CVCL_0042, 15Y female, European ancestry, tibia, osteosarcoma

limitations: Duration of the DMSO control is not stated ('alongside a DMSO control'), so exposure duration is 'not available' for light.

Protocol text says 'fractionated on a QExactive HF column' and MS1 resolution 120000 / MS2 15000; RAW headers show Q Exactive Plus at 70,000/17,500, which are used. sdrf-tools reconcile flags this (false positive) and also flags Trypsin because the protocol only says 'cleaved with 3 ug trypsin' (lowercase).

SILAC_1 and SILAC_1_REp2 produced no identifications; Blank_SILAC_7 is named a blank but contains slice-7 peptides from the late gradient after the aborted SILAC_7 run. All were searched in the deposited MaxQuant run and are annotated.
The deposit corresponds to 'Set2' of the paper's Table S1 (protein ratios match Set2 exactly per independent review); Set1 and Set3 were not deposited, so a single biological replicate is annotated.

SILAC_7 and Blank_SILAC_7 share no peptides and have non-overlapping RT windows (29.6-42.8 vs 49.4-106.2 min): they are complementary parts of one aborted slice-7 measurement, encoded as technical replicates 1 and 2 of fraction 7 because each file needs its own row.
The MaxQuant search enzyme was Trypsin/P; annotated as Trypsin.
characteristics[cellular component] = microtubule cytoskeleton describes the targeted fraction; the LMS-resistant residue also contains other cytoskeletal and nuclear proteins.
